summary: Bristol controlled airspace deactivated overnight, 23:30 to 05:00, so air traffic services are not available and frequencies are unmonitored.
text:
BRISTOL CTA/CTR/ATZ DEACTIVATED. ATS NOT AVBL, FREQUENCIES WILL 
NOT BE MONITORED. AIRSPACE REVERT TO CLASS G. IN THE EVENT OF AN 
EMERGENCY CONTACT THE CONTROL CENTRE ON 01275 473400
